annotations.title: Read a brand from a link

description: Read a site or a social profile and pull out the name, the about text, up to 6 colors and the logo, in about 20 seconds. The logo comes as it was and as a clean vector. Free, within a daily allowance. Answers with the run; its result is what it found, to start a brand from.
name: import_link
title: Read a brand from a link
